'''Green Squadron''' was the designation of a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]], which was also known as '''Green Squad'''<ref name="Lando">{{Tales|5|Lando's Commandos: On Eagles' Wings}}</ref> or '''Green Team'''.<ref name="DEa">[[Dark Empire (audio drama)|''Dark Empire'' audio drama]]</ref> The squadron participated in the [[Battle of Ession]], at which time it was a [[Bomber/Legends|bomber]] unit composed of [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL Y-wing starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]]. As a mixed unit flying Y-wings, [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighters]], and [[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter/Legends|A/SF-01 B-wing starfighters]], Green Squadron later fought in the [[Battle of Calamari]].

==History==
Following the formation of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], Green Squadron's [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] escorted a [[Convoy/Legends|convoy]] led by the [[GR-75 medium transport/Legends|GR-75 medium transport]] ''[[Dewback's Burden]]'' to [[Bhuna Sound/Legends|Bhuna Sound]], where they were ambushed by [[Eiattu pirates|pirate]] [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE interceptors]]. [[Green Leader/Legends|"Green Leader"]], a [[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter/Legends|B-wing starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]], was destroyed with the rest of the convoy.<ref name="Lando" />

During the selection period for what would become [[Wraith Squadron]], candidates including [[Kell Tainer]] and [[Hohass Ekwesh]] used the designation of Green Squadron in simulated combat missions.<ref name="wraith" />

The active Green Squadron, a [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wing]] [[Bomber/Legends|bomber]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]], was sent from [[Borleias/Legends|Borleias]] by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Horton Salm/Legends|Horton Salm]] to participate in an [[Battle of Ession|ambush]] of the [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Zsinj]]-aligned [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Implacable (Star Destroyer)/Legends|''Implacable'']] over [[Ession]]. Along with [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue]] and [[Blue Squadron (New Republic)|Blue Squadrons]], Green Squadron passed through the system's security aboard the [[Super Transport VI]] ''[[Red Feathers]]'', launching from the ancient container ship as it broke up in the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] gravity.<ref name="wraith" />

Following the [[Second Battle of Coruscant|fall of Coruscant]] in [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> the squadron's leader and a rookie [[Wingmate/Legends|wingmate]] performed a patrol mission in the [[Cyax system/Legends|Cyax system]] over the New Republic's [[Pinnacle Base]], where they encountered a target which did not broadcast any ID codes. As [[Green Leader/Legends|"Green Leader"]] and [[Green Three/Legends|"Green Three"]] moved to intercept, the commander of the vessel, New Republic [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Ackbar]], identified it as the flagship [[Defiance (MC90 Star Cruiser)|''Defiance'']] and explained that his ship had received damage to its transponder after encountering an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] convoy during a reconnaissance mission to the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Galactic Core]]. At Ackbar's request, "Green Leader" relayed his message to Republic leader [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]].<ref name="DEa" />

Working once again with Blue Squadron, Green Squadron was dispatched by Ackbar to cover the [[Battle of Calamari|evacuation]] of [[Dac/Legends|Calamari]].<ref name="DE2">[[Dark Empire 2|''Dark Empire'' 2]]</ref> Now a mixed group of B-wing, Y-wing,<ref name="CSWE" /> and [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing]] pilots, Green Squadron deployed from the New Republic Star Destroyer ''[[Emancipator]]'' and targeted the Imperial [[World Devastator]]s assaulting the planet, losing their squadron leader to a [[TIE/D automated starfighter]] in the ensuing battle.<ref name="DE3" />

Later in the [[Dark Empire|reign]] of the [[Cloning/Legends|reborn]] [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], a Green Squadron of X-wing starfighters led by another [[Green Leader (Destruction of the Pelagia)|"Green Leader"]] was in the process of boarding the [[Troop transport/Legends|troopship]] ''[[Pelagia]]'' when a [[Particle disintegrator warhead|projectile]] from the Emperor's [[Galaxy Gun]] [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] was detected on approach. Green Squadron deployed to counter the missile, but were unable to penetrate its [[Deflector shield/Legends|shielding]] and were [[Destruction of the Pelagia|destroyed]], along with the ''Pelagia''.<ref name="EEa" />

In the [[Battle of Coruscant (Yuuzhan Vong War)|Battle of Coruscant]] and [[Battle of Borleias (Yuuzhan Vong War; Second)|Battle of Borleias]] in the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], it consisted of [[E-7 E-wing multi-role starfighter|E-wings]] and served under [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Yakown Reth]]. Squadron members including Reth were reformed into [[Blackmoon Squadron]].<ref name="The New Jedi Order: Enemy Lines I: Rebel Dream">''[[The New Jedi Order: Enemy Lines I: Rebel Dream]]''</ref>

During the Battle of Coruscant, Green Squadron initially covered the ''[[Pride of Honor]]'', a New Republic capital ship. However, a [[Senator Scramblefree|senator]] ordered the squadron to protect his ship instead, resulting in extensive damage to the ''Pride of Honor''. The ''Pride of Honor'' was scrapped after the battle due to the damage it sustained.<ref name="The New Jedi Order: Destiny's Way">''[[The New Jedi Order: Destiny's Way]]''</ref>
